description: Land Title Settlement Department - Notice calling for claims to property of Intestate, Homagama D/S Division and others
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land and property matters, specifically calling for claims to intestate property under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed land descriptions including parcel numbers, map numbers, land extents, and certificate of title numbers. The notice is issued by the Commissioner General of Land Title Settlement regarding the registration of title for specific land parcels, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
